productName: Simply Love Encore Savings Insurance Plan 5

trends.whatProductOffers: A participating whole life plan providing guaranteed cash value, non-guaranteed annual dividends and non-guaranteed terminal dividend; the illustrated one-time premium case reaches its projected break-even point at the end of the 5th policy year.

keyFigures.label: Projected break-even point
keyFigures.condition: Based on current dividend scales, not guaranteed

keyFigures.label: Projected total surrender value at 40th policy year
Accumulation interest rate on Annual Dividends

exclusionsOrConditions: Annual Dividends and Terminal Dividend are non-guaranteed and declared at AIA's sole discretion.
The projected break-even point and values are illustrative only; the actual break-even may be shorter or longer.
The illustration assumes no policy loans, no Terminal Dividend Lock-in and all premiums paid in full when due.
To receive the illustrated amount the policy must be surrendered at the end of the relevant policy year.
Withdrawals reduce the principal amount and subsequent guaranteed cash value, dividends and death benefit.

trends.whatProductOffers: Change of Insured Option and Contingent Insured Option allow the policy to be passed to future generations without limit, with a contingent insured protecting the policy if the insured dies unexpectedly.
exclusionsOrConditions: The extract does not state age limits, insurability requirements or approval conditions for changing the insured.
The policy must remain in force for the options to apply.
Death Benefit Settlement Option terms are not detailed in the extract.

trends.whatProductOffers: The illustrated case withdraws US$6,250 a year from policy year 6 to policy year 40, a total of US$218,750, while a projected US$187,316 remains at year 40 for the next generation.
exclusionsOrConditions: The amount and length of cash withdrawal are non-guaranteed.
Withdrawals are deducted first from accumulated Annual Dividends with interest, then from guaranteed cash value and accrued Terminal Dividend.
Withdrawals reduce the principal amount and the death benefit.
The policy terminates when total surrender value is fully withdrawn.
